data.long_meaning: Absalom (אַבְשָׁלוֹם) is a name of Hebrew origin meaning “My father is peace; father of peace”. A compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' and שָׁלוֹם (shalom) 'peace, completeness' - 'my father is peace'. The longer form אֲבִישָׁלוֹם (ʾAvishalom) 'my father is peace' also occurs. Its root is Hebrew אַבְשָׁלוֹם (ʾAvshalom), from אָב ('av) 'father' + שָׁלוֹם (shalom) 'peace, wholeness'. Absalom is the anglicised form of Biblical Hebrew ʾAvshalom.

faq.q: What is the etymology of Absalom?
faq.a: A compound of Hebrew אָב ('av) 'father' and שָׁלוֹם (shalom) 'peace, completeness' - 'my father is peace'. The longer form אֲבִישָׁלוֹם (ʾAvishalom) 'my father is peace' also occurs.

faq.q: Does Absalom appear in the Bible?
faq.a: Yes. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (2 Samuel 3:3; 15-18).

faq.q: Is Absalom a Biblical name?
faq.a: Yes — the personal name occurs in the Biblical text. The personal name occurs in the Hebrew Bible (2 Samuel 3:3; 15-18).

faq.q: Does Absalom occur in the Old Testament?
faq.a: Yes.

faq.q: Does Absalom occur in the New Testament?
faq.a: No — it is not attested in the New Testament.

faq.q: Is Absalom associated with a saint?
faq.a: No saint association is verified for the name Absalom.

faq.q: Is the meaning of Absalom verified?
faq.a: The meaning “My father is peace; father of peace” is supported by Old Testament: Absalom, third son of King David, who rebelled against him (2 Samuel 15-18). Confidence: HIGH.

faq.q: What is the numerology or lucky number of Absalom?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Absalom total 63, reducing to 9. Number 9 is traditionally associated with compassion, idealism and completion. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.

faq.q: What are the common spelling variants of Absalom?
faq.a: Variants and alternative forms include Avshalom, Avishalom, Absalon, Axel (via Absalon).

faq.q: What is the transliteration of Absalom?
faq.a: Absalom is transliterated as ʾAvshalom.

faq.q: How many syllables does Absalom have?
faq.a: Absalom has 3 syllables.

faq.q: What are the spiritual connotations of Absalom?
faq.a: Any spiritual significance attached to Absalom is interpretive. Its documented core is the lexical meaning “My father is peace; father of peace”, and readings built on that meaning are presented as tradition rather than as religious doctrine.

faq.q: Where is the name Absalom used today?
faq.a: Absalom circulates chiefly in Biblical Hebrew, English, Greek, Latin naming communities. No verified registration statistics are published for it.
